item.title: FBI Salt Lake City announces 'record breaking' number of narcotics seized in 2025
item.description: FBI Salt Lake City has announced the "record-breaking" drug bust statistics from 2025.

item.title: New dinosaur tracks exhibit opens at St. George Dinosaur Discovery Site
item.description: To celebrate 26 years of dinosaurs at St. George Dinosaur Discovery Site, a new exhibit on dinosaur footprints is open, featuring a mural by in-house paleontologists.

item.title: No charges filed against SLCPD officer who fatally shot ninja star-wielding suspect
item.description: The Salt Lake County District Attorney's Office (SLCoDA) announced that they will not be filing charges against a Salt Lake City Police Department (SLCPD) officer who fatally shot a man in January 2025.

item.title: Funeral plans announced for South Davis Metro Fire Chief
item.description: The South Davis Metro Fire Service Area (SDMFSA) has announced funeral procession plans for Chief Greg Stewart, which may lead to delays in the area.

item.title: Police search for suspect after armed robbery in Salt Lake City
item.description: Officers responded to an AT&T store in Salt Lake City for an armed robbery and are currently looking for the suspect.

item.title: Black Physicians of Utah aims to improve representation in medical field
item.description: Black Physicians of Utah (BPOU) envisions a Utah that equitable represents persons of African descent in medical professions and eliminates racialized health disparities in the state. The organization's founder explained to ABC4 how they work to accomplish that and why it’s important.

item.title: Utah legislature considers resolution urging federal government to help save Great Salt Lake
item.description: The Utah House of Representatives is set to vote on a resolution that would urge the federal government to partner with Utah in saving the Great Salt Lake.

item.title: Governor Cox signs nine more bills from the 2026 General Legislative Session
item.description: On Friday, Utah Governor Spencer Cox signed nine bills from the 2026 General Legislative Session, codifying them into state law.

item.title: Salt Lake City VA announces upgrades to infrastructure
item.description: After the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) committed to spending a record amount of money on maintenance and repairs, the Salt Lake City VA has begun infrastructure upgrades.

item.title: Pioneer Park gets ready for major updates of aging infrastructure
item.description: Pioneer Park is getting a makeover, and on Friday, the city broke ground, celebrating the start of construction.
